assumptions: The att, lox or integrase half-sites are the canonical ones (or the ones supplied), recognised exactly.
Homologous recombination needs the stated length of identical shared sequence.
limits: Predicts which products are possible, not their yield or which dominates.
Emits only the first product as a new record; the rest are listed.
bio.jane/contract.question: What products does a site-specific or homologous recombination between these molecules give (Gateway BP/LR, Cre/loxP, a serine integrase, homology arms, CRISPR knock-in)?

description: Recombination between molecules — Gateway BP/LR (att sites), Cre/loxP, a serine integrase whose two half-sites you supply, plain homologous recombination through shared arms, or a CRISPR knock-in that keeps only products whose repair region contains every guide's cut. Emits the first product as a NEW record for downstream nodes.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

fragments.description: the molecules to react — wire upstream `record` outputs here, or name library documents.

greedy.description: permissive att core matching. Only applies when system is gateway-BP or gateway-LR. Advanced.

guides.description: protospacers whose cut must fall inside the repaired region — a product cut elsewhere by any of them is discarded and counted. Only applies when system is crispr-knock-in.

homology_bp.description: shortest homology arm that counts as a shared end. In bp. Only applies when system is homologous or crispr-knock-in.

include_subject.description: also include the node's subject as a reactant.

multi_site_only.description: keep only products where BOTH sites recombined (drops single-site intermediates). Only applies when system is gateway-BP or gateway-LR.

site1.description: the recombinase's first half-site (e.g. attP). Case is meaningful: the lower-case middle is the overlap the enzyme crosses over in. Only applies when system is recombinase.

site2.description: the recombinase's second half-site (e.g. attB), same convention. Only applies when system is recombinase.

system.description: recombination system. Values: gateway-BP (Gateway BP (attB × attP → entry)), gateway-LR (Gateway LR (attL × attR → expression)), cre-lox (Cre / loxP), recombinase (Serine integrase (your two half-sites)), homologous (Homologous recombination (shared arms)), crispr-knock-in (CRISPR knock-in (guide-gated HR)).

name: recombine

discarded.description: CRISPR knock-in only: products dropped because a guide also cuts OUTSIDE the repair. A non-zero count is a finding about the guide, not a warning to swallow

record.description: the first product, as a record

sites.description: per-input report of the recombination sites found
